interface.shortDescription: Harden software against AI reverse-engineering agents with BLA
interface.longDescription:
BLA (Blind LLM Agents) is a Counter-REA Blue Defense toolkit. This plugin teaches coding agents the Agent-Driven Hardening playbook in `.agents/skills/blind-llm-agents/SKILL.md`: when to call `bla_harden` / `bla_defend`, how to run packaging-gate lint (`bla_lint`), weave domain-plausible shadow business logic from `bla_weave_plan`, and verify with `bla_verify_weave` / `bla_verify`.

Use it when hardening your own software against AI reverse-engineering agents (REA / WorkBuddy-class), auditing release exposure, exhausting attacker token budgets, or one-click defending a project. It points agents at the existing BLA MCP tools and CLI — not at inventing new MCP surfaces. Defensive use only.
defaultPrompt: Harden this project against AI reverse-engineering agents with BLA
Audit this release for Counter-REA exposure and packaging gates
Weave domain-plausible decoys then verify with bla_verify_weave
